Author: Weslley08
Name: Soundpad Controller
Description: Play your Soundpad sounds from the keys: favorites and playback controls. Windows only; needs Soundpad running. Not affiliated with Leppsoft.
Detail: Puts Soundpad on your Ulanzi deck. Favorites: any key plays one sound, on speakers, microphone or both, and keeps playing the right one when you add, remove or reorder sounds. Controls: stop, pause, next, previous, random, replay and volume. Keys turn green while playing, yellow when paused, red when Soundpad is closed and grey when a sound is gone. It talks to Soundpad only on your computer, through Soundpad's own remote control, and sends nothing over the internet. Requires Soundpad on Windows. Soundpad is a product of Leppsoft; this plugin is not affiliated with Leppsoft or Ulanzi.
